definitions.gloss: door chime; doorbell that plays a chime tone
definitions.explanation: A doorbell device that produces a melodic chime when pressed, typical of Japanese homes and apartments. The term is also used for the chime sound that plays when train or shop doors open.

examples.japanese: ドアチャイム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
ドアチャイム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{宅配|たくはい}→宅配：09571_takuhai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ドアチャイム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鳴|な}らした→鳴らす：02381_narasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The delivery person rang the door chime, but no one answered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドアチャイム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}→訪問者：20148_houmonsha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many recent apartment door chimes come with cameras so you can check who is visiting.

notes:
ドアチャイム is a wasei-eigo compound ("door" + "chime") referring to a doorbell, typically one that plays a soft melodic chime rather than a harsh buzz.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドアチャイム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to press the door chime
- ドアチャイム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鳴|な}らす→鳴らす：02381_narasu⟧: to ring the door chime
- ドアチャイム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: the door chime rings
- ドアチャイム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to answer the door (when the chime rings)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インターホン→インターホン：04885_intaahon⟧: intercom — combines a chime with a two-way audio (and often video) communication system; this is what most modern Japanese apartments actually have, though many people still call it ドアチャイム casually
- ⟦{呼|よ}び{鈴|りん}→呼び鈴：21575_yobirin⟧: doorbell (more old-fashioned native term)
- ドアベル: door bell (alternative loanword, less common)
- ⟦チャイム→チャイム：00024_chaimu⟧: chime (general — also used for school bells, train chimes, and the boarding chime in trains)

USAGE:
- In conversation, ドアチャイム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ and ⟦インターホン→インターホン：04885_intaahon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ are often used interchangeably, even though they technically refer to slightly different devices.
- The ピンポーン sound that the chime makes is so iconic that ピンポーン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ is a common informal way to say "the doorbell rang."
